India loves charity. We donate crores to temples, talk proudly about generosity, and celebrate ourselves as a “kind” society. But when it comes to the people working right next to us—househelps, security guards, delivery boys, waiters, drivers—the humanity suddenly disappears.

In this video, we expose the brutal reality faced by India’s most exploited workforce. From maids being beaten and held hostage, to guards being slapped in public, to delivery workers risking their lives for ₹20–₹50 per order—this is the side of India we conveniently ignore. Educated, affluent societies abusing poor workers. Cheap labour treated worse than animals.

We also talk about the uncomfortable truth: low wages, zero job security, no insurance, no dignity—and why a single hospital bill can destroy these families overnight. Alongside exploitation, we also discuss real concerns, misuse, and why the solution isn’t blind sympathy but strong labour laws, minimum wages, and basic respect.

This is not a feel-good video. It’s a mirror.
